description: Unit tests for MIME type utility functions in the Chromium project, including MIME type parsing, extension mapping, boundary generation, and multipart form data construction.

methods.name: GetWellKnownMimeTypeFromExtension
methods.description: Retrieves MIME type for a given file extension, case-insensitive, including handling null bytes.

methods.name: GetMimeTypeFromExtension
methods.description: Retrieves MIME type(s) for a given file extension, supporting multiple MIME types.

methods.name: GetMimeTypeFromFile
methods.description: Determines MIME type based on file path.

methods.name: MatchesMimeType
methods.description: Checks if a MIME type matches a pattern, supporting wildcards and case insensitivity.

methods.name: ParseMimeType
methods.description: Parses a MIME type string into type, subtype, and parameters.

methods.name: ParseMimeTypeWithoutParameter
methods.description: Parses MIME type string without parameters into top-level type and subtype.

methods.name: ExtractMimeTypeFromMediaType
methods.description: Extracts MIME type from media type string, handling multiple types and parameters.

methods.name: IsValidTopLevelMimeType
methods.description: Validates if a string is a recognized top-level MIME type.

methods.name: GetExtensionsForMimeType
methods.description: Retrieves file extensions associated with a MIME type.

methods.name: GenerateMimeMultipartBoundary
methods.description: Generates a unique MIME multipart boundary string.

methods.name: AddMultipartValueForUpload
methods.description: Adds a multipart form data section with specified name, value, boundary, and content type.

methods.name: AddMultipartValueForUploadWithFileName
methods.description: Adds a multipart form data section with filename, name, value, boundary, and content type.

methods.name: AddMultipartFinalDelimiterForUpload
methods.description: Adds the final boundary delimiter for multipart form data.

methods.name: GetPreferredExtensionForMimeType
methods.description: Retrieves preferred file extension for a given MIME type.
